title: Riot X Nic Salts Strawberry Orange Crush 10ml E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Orange Crush by Riot X Nic Salts combines zesty citrus with sweet summer berries for a refreshing and well-rounded vape. The inhale features the bright, tangy notes of fresh Orange, delivering a sharp and vibrant citrus taste. This is perfectly complemented by the soft, juicy sweetness of ripe Strawberry on the exhale, creating a highly satisfying fruit profile from start to finish. This e-liquid features Riot's Hybrid Nicotine formula, which blends Nic Salt and freebase for quick satisfaction, a smooth throat feel, and modest vapour production. With its 50VG/50PG profile, this vape juice is best suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping and performs well with pod kits, refillable starter kits, and compact vape pens. Made in the UK, the Riot X Nic Salts range focuses on full-impact fruit blends designed for everyday use in low-powered refillable devices.
